sections.title: What "AI skills" means in job descriptions

blocks.title: Not from your PDFs
blocks.text: No guide of yours covers this, so this page was written for the site, as of October 2026. Tools and versions change quickly: check the official documentation before relying on details.

blocks: It usually does **not** mean training neural networks. For a Java full stack developer it means two things: using AI tools to work faster and safely, and building features on top of AI models using normal engineering.

rows: Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor: generating, reviewing, testing and debugging with AI
Calling LLM APIs, RAG, vector search, tools and agents from Spring
Many backend and full stack roles
blocks.caption: My reading of the market, not a formal survey.

blocks.title: What postings actually say
blocks.text: A small sample of 2026 listings asks for things like LLMs, RAG, vector databases and AI APIs, Java libraries such as Spring AI and LangChain4j, and using copilots for development tasks. Many of these are senior or contract roles, so read this as a direction rather than a requirement for every 3 to 4 year job.

blocks.title: AI learning path
blocks.code:
flowchart TD
  A[How LLMs behave] --> B[AI-assisted development]
  B --> C[Spring AI: chat and structured output]
  C --> D[RAG and vector search]
  D --> E[Tools, agents and MCP]
  E --> F[Production: evaluation, security, cost]
  F --> G[Build and ship one project]
blocks.caption: This is the rest of this stage. Steady pace: 3 to 4 weeks of evenings.

sections.title: How it shows up in interviews

rows: How do you use AI tools in your work?
Productive and critical: you review and test the output
Add a support chatbot over our documents
RAG design, citations, failure handling, cost
How do you stop it inventing answers?
How do you know it works?
Evaluation sets, not a few manual tries
Prompt injection, data leakage, cost, latency

blocks.title: Key points
blocks.text:
- You do not need to train models.
- AI-assisted development is now a baseline.
- Integrating LLMs is backend engineering you can already mostly do.
- One shipped feature beats many courses.

items.question: A posting asks for "GenAI experience". What can you honestly offer after this stage?
items.answer: A deployed feature using RAG with Spring AI, its evaluation results and costs, and how you use AI tools in development. Describe it as project experience; do not claim production experience you lack.

items.question: Do you need to learn Python for AI roles?
items.answer: Not for Java application roles: Spring AI and LangChain4j cover integration. Reading basic Python helps, as many examples use it. Dedicated AI teams may require it.
